Rooms.Name: The Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
You climb down the ladder into a damp room. The only light comes 
from the north where a little campfire burns. To the east you hear 
the faint sound of footsteps.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The entire tunnel gradually slopes downward, and the floor is 
covered with small rocks from holes in the wall. It looks like 
someone has been mining for something.

Exits.Description: You see the guard post.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The entire tunnel gradually slopes downward, and the floor is 
covered with small rocks from holes in the wall. It looks like 
someone has been mining for something.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The entire tunnel gradually slopes downward, and the floor is 
covered with small rocks from holes in the wall. It looks like 
someone has been mining for something.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel makes a sharp turn to the east. You can see light 
flickering ahead.

Exits.Description: You see some flickering lights ahead.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel continues and to the east you see a large cave. The 
flickering light is getting stronger and you can make out a 
campfire at the end of the cave.

Exits.Description: You see a large cave.

Rooms.Name: The Large Cave
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel comes out in large cave. Further east you see a large 
black door covered with strange runes. A campfire makes the whole 
cave light up. To the north you see a couple of beds made of straw.

Exits.Description: You see a couple of mattresses made of straw.
You see a the huge black door.
You see the mining tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The Beds
Rooms.Description:
Around you are four beds made of straw. A table and two chairs is 
the only furniture besides the beds. To the east you see a large pile 
of stone.

Exits.Description: You see a large pile of stone.
You see the entrance to the cave.

Rooms.Name: The North-East Corner
Rooms.Description:
In front of you is a large pile of stone. The stone probably comes 
from the mining in the tunnel. To the south you see the campfire 
and the huge black door. The straw beds are to the west.

Exits.Description: You see the huge black door.
You see a couple of beds made of straw.

Rooms.Name: In Front of the Black Door
Rooms.Description:
Who or what ever built this door must have been enormous. The 
door measures ten meters in height and five meters in width, and 
the whole door is covered with arcane writings. Maybe you should 
turn back while you can.

Exits.Description: You see a large pile of stone.
The black door towers above you. Two meters up you see a large keyhole.
You see the entrance to the cave.

Rooms.Name: The Staircase
Rooms.Description:
Before you a huge staircase formed of gray stone leads down into 
darkness. To the west you hear the sound of fire burning.

Exits.Description: The black door towers above you. Two meters up you see a large keyhole.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
As you enter the dark mining tunnel you notice a draft coming 
from within. The tunnel continues into the dark. To the West you 
here a fire burning.

Exits.Description: You see the guard post.

Rooms.Name: The T-cross
Rooms.Description:
The mining tunnel divides into two tunnels, one north and one 
south. From the south you hear footsteps and distant muttering.

Rooms.Name: Turn in the Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description: The mining tunnel makes a sharp turn to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Cave-In
Rooms.Description:
The mining tunnel comes to an abrupt end. The tunnel in front of 
you looks like it has collapsed.

Exits.Description: You see a little opening at the top of the stones.

Rooms.Name: The Collapsed Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The whole tunnel seems too have collapsed. Remains of two skeletons 
can be found on the floor. Maybe you should get out of here before you 
join them.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel makes a sharp turn to the east. Further east you see 
light flickering.

Rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
As you move forward you smell the scent of roasted meat. The sound 
of muttering is getting louder.

Exits.Description: You see a light in the distance.

Rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel emerges into a huge cave. To the south you see the cause 
of the smell, a large cauldron over a campfire.

Exits.Description: You see a large Cauldron.

Rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
Rooms.Description: Lots of bones and junk have been thrown away here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the cave.

Rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
Rooms.Description: A large cauldron is placed over a campfire here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the cave.

Rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
Rooms.Description:
In this corner of the cave the Black Orcs practice their fighting 
skills.

Exits.Description: You see a large Cauldron and some beds made of straw.

Rooms.Name: The Staircase
Rooms.Description:
You are in a very large cave room. You can see a metal sign nailed 
on the wall. To the north a large corridor continues into the unknown 
and a huge staircase leads up.

Rooms.Name: The Corridor
Rooms.Description: You are in a large north-south leading corridor.

Rooms.Name: The Cave Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You see a large cave filled with stalagmites and stalactites to 
the north and east. You can enter a corridor to the south.

Rooms.Name: The South-East Corner of Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The air is very moist here and 
water is dripping from the walls. The cave continues to the north and 
the west.

Rooms.Name: The South-West Corner of the Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The air is very moist here and 
water is dripping from the walls. The cave continues to north and east.

Rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The cave seems much bigger now. 
The cave continues in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. You can see big stalagmites 
hanging above your head. The cave continues to the north, south 
and west.

Rooms.Name: Near the Big Boulder
Rooms.Description:
You are in the large stalagmite cave near a big boulder. You can 
see a carving on the boulder's left side. The cave continues to the 
north, south and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You can read the words 'OPEN ME'

Rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a large stalagmite cave. The cave 
continues in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a large stalagmite cave. The floor is 
covered with water puddles. The cave continues in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The floor is covered with water 
puddles. The cave continues to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue north into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) or continue south and east.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss

Rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue north into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) or continue south, east and west.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss

Rooms.Name: Near the Narrow Stone Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You see a narrow stone bridge to the North. The cave continues to 
the south, east and west.

Exits.Description: You see a stone bridge

Rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue north into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) or continue south and west.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss

Rooms.Name: In the abyss
Rooms.Description: You are faaaaaaalling down into the dark abyss.

Rooms.Name: In the Abyss
Rooms.Description: You are faaaaaaaling down into the dark abyss.

Rooms.Name: On the Narrow Stone Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a narrow stone bridge. It looks very slippery 
and wet. You better be careful because it's a long way down. You can 
continue east and west into the abyss or south and north to the cave.

Rooms.Name: In the Abyss
Rooms.Description: You are faaaaaaaling down into the dark abyss.

Rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue south into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) and east to the cave.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss.

Rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue south into the abyss (not 
a very wise decision), east, west and north to the cave.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss.

Rooms.Name: Near the Narrow Stone Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You see a narrow stone bridge to the South. The cave continues to 
the east and west.

Exits.Description: You see the caves go north.
You see a stone bridge.

Rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue south into the abyss (not 
a very wise decision) and west to the cave.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss.

Rooms.Name: The Corridor
Rooms.Description: You are in a large south-west leading corridor.

Rooms.Name: The Crypt Entrance
Rooms.Description:
The corridor ends up at a huge stone door to the west. You can see 
a large inscription on the door. The corridor continues to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a huge stone door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You can read the words 'Sealed by the last dwarfs in moria year 781'

Rooms.Name: The Passage
Rooms.Description:
You are in a very narrow tunnel. The floor is covered with dust. 
The  tunnel continues into a large crypt to the south and east to 
a corridor.

Exits.Description: You see a huge stone door.
You see the crypt.

Rooms.Name: The Crypt
Rooms.Description:
Lit torches line the walls of the crypt. You can see a big throne 
at the end of the room. A thick layer of dust covers the floor. It 
looks like nobody has been here for ages. In the middle of the room 
you see a large stone chest with arcane writings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This was the former throne of the Dwarven  king. On the side you can 
read the history of the king and about his many brave adventures.
The lid on the stone chest seems too be moveable.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of the Dwarven king
Rooms.Description:
You climb down into the stone chest. Something about this makes your 
backbone shiver. This place does not seem to like your intrusion. You 
can see the remains of a powerful looking dwarf. He wears a shining 
plate and wields two-handed axe. Maybe you shouldn't disturb him. The 
only exit seems to be up.

Rooms.Name: In the Cottage
Rooms.Description:
You are in a very small and dirty cottage. The floor is covered with 
garbage and junk. The only furniture in the room is a small straw bed 
and a cabinet. The only exit is to the south.

Exits.Description: You can see a small rickety door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The cabinet is filled with jars and rather disgusting food.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Cottage
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small island outside a cottage. You can continue North 
into the cottage or East into the water.

Exits.Description: You can see a small rickety door.

Rooms.Name: On the Lake
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small lake in the cave. This part of the lake seems to 
be very deep. The lake continues to the east and you can see a small 
island to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the Lake
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small lake in the cave. The water seems to be almost 
black. The lake continues to the west and you can see a small beach 
to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Small Beach
Rooms.Description:
You are on a very small beach. The only exits are up on a 
ladder or south on a small lake.

Exits.Description: You can see a large boulder.

Rooms.Name: Behind the Cabinet
Rooms.Description: You step in behind the cabinet. The only exit is back to the east.

Rooms.Name: An Empty Room
Rooms.Description: Hey you, get outta here!  This is an empty room!

Mobs.Name: large black orc
Mobs.LongDescription: A large Black Orc screams some strange words and charges you.
Mobs.Description:
The Black Orc looks rather mean and agressive.
He waves his scimitar in a very threatening manner.

Mobs.Name: huge black orc leader
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge Black Orc screams some commands to his followers and charges you.
Mobs.Description:
This Black Orc looks very very mean and muscular.
He is dressed in an ill-fitting black plate and thrusts his
spear at you.

Mobs.Name: enormous black orc chief
Mobs.LongDescription: A Enormous Black Orc screams some commands to his followers and charges you.
Mobs.Description:
This Black Orc looks very very mean and  muscular.
He is dressed in an well-fitting huge evil black plate
and tries to pierce you with his spear.

Mobs.Name: balrog humanoid enormous fire
Mobs.LongDescription: An enormous humanoid form of fire snickers cruelly at your weak efforts.
Mobs.Description:
It is surrounded by sparkling and lethal fire.  It is holding a mighty 
whip in its left hand and a flaming sword in its right hand.  Around its
neck you see the infamous Glob Medallion, and you know its soul is owned
by an evil force.

Mobs.Name: Gollum
Mobs.LongDescription: Gollum sniffs loud and looks at you with his big fish eyes.
Mobs.Description:
This guy really looks like he need something to eat.
He is small and tiny and his skin is almost transparent.
Mobs.ActionScript: %15 cry;%15 say Someone have stolen my ring.

Mobs.Name: Octopussy blind
Mobs.LongDescription: The Octopussy attacks you with its slimy tentacles.
Mobs.Description: This is a creature from the deepest part of the pool.

Objects.Name: scimitar black
Objects.Description: A black scimitar has been left here.

Objects.Name: spear black
Objects.Description: A strange black spear has been left here.

Objects.Name: black breast plate
Objects.Description: A black breast plate is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: black chain mail
Objects.Description: A black chain mail is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: black shield
Objects.Description: A black shield is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: black amulet
Objects.Description: A black amulet is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: key huge black
Objects.Description: A black key is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: crypt key
Objects.Description: A crypt key is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: dwarven mithril plate
Objects.Description: A dwarven mithril plate is lying here on the ground.

Objects.Name: dwarven two-handed mithril axe
Objects.Description: A dwarven two-handed mithril axe is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: sword flaming
Objects.Description: A flaming sword is lying here.

Objects.Name: whip flaming
Objects.Description: A flaming whip is lying here.

Objects.Name: ring old
Objects.Description: An old ring is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You read the inscription.
     One ring to rule them all,
     One ring to .......

Objects.Name: coins
Objects.Description: a huge amount of coins is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The jar is half full of some disgusting liquid.

Objects.Name: medallion eye glob
Objects.Description: An ever-vigilant eye watches from its glowing red-orange background.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An extremely secret, extremely evil society, Glob Inc has tentacles that
have threaded their way into the heart of societies around the world.
New members are given this medallion or some other piece of body wear
bearing the Glob insignia.  They are told that it is a gift and a means
for them to identify themselves to others.  But they all experience a
feeling of being watched, ever afterwards.

Little is known about this society.  Perhaps it is best not to know too
much.
